security.csp: default-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'ipc: http://ipc.localhost'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Installs Syncord into your Discord client.
bundle.longDescription: Finds every Discord client installed on this machine and installs or removes Syncord from the one you choose. Every payload is verified against the Syncord release signature before anything is written.
